product.name: Solar Panels
product.description: Photovoltaic panels installed on rooftops to generate electricity from sunlight for residential and commercial use.

product.name: Physical and Virtual Batteries
product.description: Energy storage solutions that store excess solar energy for use during low production periods or to share energy between locations.

product.name: Electric Vehicle Chargers
product.description: Home charging stations connected to solar panels for charging electric vehicles using self-generated solar energy.

product.name: Aerothermal Systems
product.description: Heating and cooling systems that use ambient air heat to regulate indoor temperatures efficiently.

product.name: Solar Subscription Service
product.description: A subscription-based model allowing customers to use solar energy without upfront investment, including maintenance and repairs.

product.name: Solar Installation and Permit Management
product.description: End-to-end service covering technical assessment, permit processing, installation, and system commissioning for solar energy projects.
